segments.text: SQLite single file magic breaks the moment you need a task Q. Honker is a loadable SQLite extension written in Rust that brings Postgress style notify
and listen natively to seeite. Durable pub sub task cues event streams all in your existing database file. Same atomic
transaction for business logic and Q tasks. No polling. Singled digit millisecond latency.
